{"implementation": "import math
def solve(case):
    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    n_rows = len(matrix)
    n_cols = len(idf) if matrix else 0
    if any(len(row) != n_cols for row in matrix):
        raise ValueError('Inconsistent matrix column count')
    if len(vector) != n_rows:
        raise ValueError('Vector length mismatch')
    scaled = [[elem * idf[j] for j, elem in enumerate(row)] for row in matrix]
    eps = 1e-10
    degrees = [max(sum(x*x for x in row), eps) for row in scaled]
    inv_sqrt_d = [1.0 / math.sqrt(d) for d in degrees]
    v_hat = [vector[i] * inv_sqrt_d[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    temp = [0.0] * n_cols
    for i in range(n_rows):
        vi = v_hat[i]
        row = scaled[i]
        for j in range(n_cols):
            temp[j] += row[j] * vi
    result_unscaled = [0.0] * n_rows
    for i in range(n_rows):
        row = scaled[i]
        s = 0.0
        for j in range(n_cols):
            s += row[j] * temp[j]
        result_unscaled[i] = s
    result = [result_unscaled[i] * inv_sqrt_d[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    degree_out = [round(d, 10) for d in degrees]
    result_out = [round(r, 10) for r in result]
    return {'degree': degree_out, 'result': result_out}"}
